title: Fuel Arrears Settled Out of a Membership and Patronage Equity Revolvement Payment
content:
What the member owes on their fuel account is settled out of the payment in the offset order the class fixes. The accounts read are the member's Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts.

**First.** Where a refined fuels account stands past due with a balance still standing on it, the balance standing on that account is taken off.

**Second.** Where no refined fuels account stands past due and a refined fuels account stands active with contracted gallons still owed on it, those gallons are taken off at the account's contracted price, the figure rounded to two decimal places.

**Third.** Where neither stands, nothing is taken off.

## Input, judgement, output, on hypothetical figures

> **Input.** A refined fuels account standing past due with 870.00 on it; an active account owing 400 contracted gallons at a contracted price of 2.15 a gallon.
> **Judgement.** The first line holds and the order is not reached beyond it.
> **Output.** 870.00 is taken off.

> **Input.** No refined fuels account standing past due; an active account owing 400 contracted gallons at a contracted price of 2.15 a gallon.
> **Judgement.** The second line holds.
> **Output.** 400 gallons at 2.15 a gallon, which is 860.00, is taken off.

> **Input.** A refined fuels account standing past due but carrying nothing; an active account owing 400 contracted gallons at 2.15 a gallon.
> **Judgement.** The first line requires a balance still standing on the past-due account, and none stands; the second line is the one that holds.
> **Output.** 860.00 is taken off.

> **Input.** No past-due account and no contracted gallons owed on an active account.
> **Judgement.** Neither line holds.
> **Output.** Nothing is taken off.

What is so taken off is taken off the payment Membership and Patronage Equity would otherwise pay, and the remainder is floored at nothing.
